result.summary: The interface appears functional, showing only minor inconsistencies in information hierarchy and visual asset styling.

issues.description: Information badges are inconsistent; carousel cards overlay time, while list cards overlay delivery fees.
issues.suggestion: Standardize which data points appear as overlays versus text labels across all card formats.

issues.description: Simplified vector illustrations are used for food items, appearing like placeholder assets rather than real products.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic illustrations with high-quality photography of actual food to improve user engagement.
